description.value: Summerhill Pyramid Winery is Canada's most-visited organic and biodynamic winery, nestled on the east shore of Okanagan Lake with sweeping views of the lake and surrounding mountains. The estate is anchored by a full-scale replica Egyptian pyramid used to age and clarify wines, a concept unique in the wine world. Touring cyclists will find a full bistro restaurant, a wine shop, and regular special events in a scenic lakeside setting accessible by public transit.

address.value: 4870 Chute Lake Road, Kelowna, BC V1W 4M3
